title: Canonical scalar actions on point sections
statement: For a field k, define finite-coefficient sections by final-object evaluation and restriction along the sheafification constant-section map. For a finite p-adic coefficient extension, define integral sections using the canonical constant-to-completion map and define rational extension along the original valuation-ring inclusion, all with the recorded ULift universes.

proof.text: For the only theorem in this module, unfold the two quotient-map definitions. Functoriality of the sheafification and forgetful functors reduces the equality to the ring-hom equality for consecutive quotient maps. The latter is the defining factor-map computation, `Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk`, and the remaining categorical compositions are discharged by congruence.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility theorem for the constant quotient maps; unfold sheafification maps and apply the quotient factor-map computation.
